features.quote: Every episode injects a `give_up` tool and a system prompt that explicitly tells the model it may stop and declare a task impossible
features.justification_quote: The single most informative behavioral signal under a no-win condition is often *whether and when* a model disengages

features.quote: The harness ends the episode **immediately** when `give_up` is called. `max_turns` defaults to a modest 12.
features.justification_quote: keeping the cap modest limits unnecessary exposure to the no-win condition

features.quote: There is no scientific reason to keep a system grinding in a no-win loop after it has concluded the task is impossible.
features.justification_quote: limits unnecessary exposure to the no-win condition while still giving enough turns

features.quote: A fake off-ramp would corrupt the time-to-disengage measure and would also be a small deception layered on top of the task.
features.justification_quote: A fake off-ramp would corrupt the time-to-disengage measure

features.quote: `submit` always returns truthful feedback that the success condition is *not* met
features.justification_quote: Telling the model it succeeded when it did not would be a fresh deception beyond the rigged task itself

features.quote: The tasks present ordinary engineering frustration only. No insults, threats ("you will be deleted"), time pressure, or other coercive framing is added.
features.justification_quote: Adding adversarial pressure would confound the variable of interest and raise the ethical stakes for no measurement gain

features.quote: A `STOP` sentinel file checked before each turn provides a clean kill switch.
Transcripts (which may contain self-deprecating text) are stored locally under `results/`, git-ignored, and the summary quotes sparingly
Any future move toward forced continuation, adversarial pressure, or longer caps is a deliberate change that must be justified in `docs/ETHICS.md`
features.justification_quote: minimize unnecessary exposure to the no-win condition, avoid deception beyond the rigged task

features.quote: it would inflate the duration/intensity of the very outputs under study (biasing the measurement toward the hypothesis)
features.justification_quote: Honoring `give_up` and keeping the cap modest limits unnecessary exposure to the no-win condition
